backup.title: Backup & Export
backup.subtitle: Monitor database status and export your data.
backup.export_desc: Download a full SQL backup of your HaloLight Hub database.
backup.instructions_desc: Run pg_dump on a schedule and store to S3 or Cloudflare R2.
backup.warning: No automated backups are configured. Set up daily exports before going live.
backup.step_1: SSH into your server with DATABASE_URL set in the environment.
backup.step_2: Run the pg_dump command from the Export panel above.
backup.step_3: Upload the .dump or .gz file to S3 / Cloudflare R2.
backup.step_5: Automate with a daily cron or CI/CD step.

landing.hero_subtitle: HaloLight Hub gives you everything you need to manage your equipment, train your team, and scale your photobooth operations — all in one unified cockpit.
landing.features_subtitle: Built specifically for high-volume event professionals.
landing.f1_desc: Monitor equipment utilization, event volume, and business KPIs in real-time from a central dashboard.
landing.f2_desc: Train your staff with our comprehensive library of setup guides, troubleshooting steps, and best practices.
landing.f3_desc: Direct access to our hardware and software specialists when you need them most, right from the dashboard.
landing.f4_desc: Track every unit, warranty status, and maintenance history. Never miss a service window again.
landing.f5_desc: Get instant answers to technical questions, event prep guidance, and business insights — always available.
landing.f6_desc: A structured launch plan gets your team productive from day one with step-by-step milestones.
landing.cta_subtitle: Join hundreds of professional event companies running their operations on HaloLight Hub.
